option.block: v2v_intent ON widens actor/critic inputs by V2V_INTENT_DIM=48 zero-initialised columns (extend_for_v2v style, INSERT_AT=29) and attaches the intent head; OFF keeps every code path byte-identical

model.widen: extend_for_v2v(model, extra_dim, intent_horizon=0, intent_bounds=INTENT_BOUNDS): zero-init input widening for actor AND critic; with intent_horizon>0 also add_intent_head
model.intent_head: add_intent_head: small zero-initialised nn.Linear(64, H) off the shared actor trunk (actor[:-1]); clipped to the action clip (persistent=False buffers intent_low/intent_high, sourced from binding accel_bounds [-3., 2.6], never hand-set); new module appended LAST so loaded parameter order - and therefore the executed action - is unchanged
model.forward: forward_with_intent(model, x, rsu) -> (mean, value, planned): mean/value byte-identical to forward_with_v2v, planned = intent(hidden).clamp(bounds); narrow rows zero-padded (absent v2v channels read as zeros)
model.load_checkpoint: v2v_extra resolves 48 for {'v2v_intent': True} (supersedes plain v2v width); _load_extended accepts checkpoints with or without intent.* keys (missing non-intent keys and any unexpected key still raise); _rebuilt_optimizer now appends newly attached head indices to the saved Adam group (fresh moments) so base->widen+intent loads
model.targets: intent_examples(episodes, horizon, bounds): per record/step i, member v: target[j] = realised absolute acceleration at step i+1+j (requests requested_raw, else baseline command - the accel_runner absolute_accels convention), clipped to bounds; mask[j]=0 at episode end or once v is no longer commanded (despawn)
model.loss: intent_loss: masked mean squared command error (m/s^2)^2; intent_error: masked mean absolute error m/s^2 (the before/after metric)

losses.ppo: accel_learner.update(..., intent=None): with the registered intent dict the masked intent loss is added as intent['weight']*penalty to the PPO objective for ALL ARMS identically (A-v2v, B-v2v, R-v2v call the same update); a final metrics entry intent={weight, horizon, error_before_mps2, error_after_mps2, rule} is appended when on; intent=None keeps the registered metric schema and numerics unchanged (tested)
losses.exact: exact_grade._ppo_exact_update/exact_update(..., intent=None): same intent loss on the rollout records only (bank pairs have no next-step tape), same summary entry; forwards intent to the bank pass
losses.bank: bank_imitation.run_separate(..., intent=None): pairs carrying context['intent_target'] add the masked plan-future loss with the same registered weight inside every imitation minibatch (subject to the unchanged separate-KL bound); report['intent'] carries before/after; legacy run() untouched (byte-for-byte)

bank_targets.attach: bank_v2v.attach_pairs(..., plan=None, intent=False, intent_horizon=5): when intent and plan are given, each kept pair also carries context['intent_target'] = {vid: {target[H], mask[H]}}; without intent the pairs are byte-identical to the plain v2v attachment (tested)
bank_targets.source: bank_v2v.plan_intent_targets(plan, elapsed, members, horizon, bounds): the winning plan's ABSOLUTE commands at elapsed+1..elapsed+H via plans.acceleration_at (the executed plan itself is the label), zero-masked beyond plan duration, clipped to the action bounds, members outside the plan omitted
bank_targets.call_site: replay_bank.bank_pairs(..., intent=False, intent_horizon=5) passes plan + intent flags to attach_pairs (DEFAULT OFF = byte-identical)

update_json: intent error before/after lands in {arm}_UPDATE_{u:03}.json: ppo metrics carry the intent summary entry and a top-level intent key is added (both runners) ONLY when the option is on - warm_runner.py and accel_runner.py extract it exactly like the existing bank_imitation key; option off adds no key (byte-identical receipts)
call_sites: tools/coopmwm/v2v_model.py - constants (V2V_INTENT_K/H/BASE, INTENT_BOUNDS, DEFAULT_INTENT_WEIGHT, V2V_INTENT_DIM), intent_options/intent_config/v2v_extra, add_intent_head/forward_with_intent/planned_commands, intent_examples/intent_loss/intent_error, extend_for_v2v/_rebuilt_optimizer/_load_extended/load_checkpoint
tools/coopmwm/warm_runner.py - intent_config(b) -> update/exact_update + conditional intent key in the update receipt
tools/coopmwm/accel_runner.py - intent_config(b) -> update + conditional intent key in the update receipt

config_keys.clip: binding accel_bounds ([-3., 2.6]); no hand-set behavioural thresholds

covers: option resolution: v2v_intent default OFF; width K*(6+H+1)=48 supersedes plain v2v; horizon/weight overrides; intent_config clip from binding accel_bounds
executed action IDENTICAL at load: zero-init widened inputs under arbitrary channel values + zero-init intent head; planned starts neutral and action-clipped
checkpoint save/load round trip at intent width (weights restored); plain checkpoint loads with option on (zero-init head, optimizer moments remapped with fresh head moments)
intent head trains through accel_learner.update: supervised planned-vs-realised next-H error falls to <20% of before on a synthetic learnable sequence; also through widened 48-channel v2v contexts
masking: episode end, despawn (member leaves commands), requests-over-baseline fallback, clip to the action bounds

bank plan-future targets: plans.acceleration_at labels, beyond-duration masking, non-plan members omitted; run_separate(intent) trains the head and reports before/after; legacy run() and intent-off run_separate carry no intent block
shared trunk: a warmed head pushes intent gradient into the actor trunk features

constraints.no_handset_thresholds: none added; the intent clip is the binding's own action clip (accel_bounds), the loss weight is a registered config default, all other thresholds are structural (dimensions, horizon, latency)

how_to_enable: run binding/cfg: v2v_intent=true, v2v_dim=48 (tools.coopmwm.v2v_obs.V2V_INTENT_DIM), optionally v2v_intent_horizon/v2v_intent_weight; part A's runtime gates (v2v_runner.prepare(..., v2v_intent=True), v2v_live.intent_binding_gate, controller publish hooks) feed the widened contexts and the intent buffer this part trains against; part C/D (c4-intent-int) owns the end-to-end launch wiring
